purpose: Prospective confirmation of fixed per-motor fitting procedure, declared before any confirmation motion.
candidate_selection: Combine the final bounded fit for every ID 4-12 without selecting by confirmation outcome. Preserve bound hits and failed fit outcomes. Baseline remains unchanged.
primary_comparison: Equal-sample pooled RMS encoder prediction error across all three complete fresh trials, with per-motor pooled comparisons and every trial retained. Same controller with simulated feedback.
secondary_comparison: Recorded PWM replay on the same fresh captures. Not used to tune this candidate.
acceptance: Original per-motor per-trial 3 encoder-count RMS prediction gate remains; comparative improvement is not accuracy acceptance. Report any per-motor regression even if the pooled average improves. Incomplete captures retained as failures and never scored as complete.
controller: Same frozen FPGA image and fixed gains, 75 or 100 per-mille drive cap according to frozen plans. No candidate changes to hardware gains.
electrical_scope: Voltage telemetry only; raw current cannot establish amps, watts, common resistance, electronics draw, or battery accuracy. Supply scenarios are explicit sensitivity hypotheses, not calibrated bench parameters.
timing_scope: 150 ms all-nine scheduled cadence; sensor sample age unknown. No maximum-speed, complete reversal-time, loaded torque or endurance rating.
